description:
Suma o resta N días hábiles a una fecha usando los festivos de Colombia (plazos legales, facturas, SLA). Cuándo: hay que aplicar con exactitud una regla colombiana (DIAN, festivos de la Ley Emiliani, montos en COP, IVA, GMF, UVT), p. ej. al facturar o cobrar. No para: sumar o restar días hábiles, saltando fines de semana y festivos dados (business-days-add). Efectos secundarios: ninguno (solo lectura, sin red, sin estado guardado). Determinista: la misma entrada da la misma salida. Límites: entrada JSON de hasta 64 KB, 1 s por llamada, resultado de hasta 1 MB.

EN: Adds or subtracts N business days (días hábiles) to a date using Colombian national holidays, e.g. for legal deadlines, invoices or SLA due dates. When: a Colombian rule (DIAN, Ley Emiliani holidays, COP amounts, IVA, GMF, UVT) has to be applied exactly, e.g. in invoicing or payment flows. Not for: adding or subtracting business days, skipping weekends and given holidays (business-days-add). [EN completo / full EN: inputSchema.description]

inputSchema.description: EN: Adds or subtracts N business days (días hábiles) to a date using Colombian national holidays, e.g. for legal deadlines, invoices or SLA due dates. When: a Colombian rule (DIAN, Ley Emiliani holidays, COP amounts, IVA, GMF, UVT) has to be applied exactly, e.g. in invoicing or payment flows. Not for: adding or subtracting business days, skipping weekends and given holidays (business-days-add). Side effects: none (read-only, no network access, no stored state). Deterministic: the same input gives the same output. Limits: JSON input up to 64 KB, 1 s per call, result up to 1 MB.

date.description: YYYY-MM-DD (string; required; up to 10 chars; format date).

days.description: Business days (negative subtracts) (integer; required; min -5000; max 5000).

saturday_is_business.description: Saturday counts as business day (boolean; optional; default false).
